$comment.why: sound-sourcing/scripts is numeric DSP code (numpy arrays, frame and sample math), test-fixture tables and calls to fixed library APIs. Dense arithmetic raises operand counts, live locals and Python body depth without a control-flow problem. Each minor metric is set just past the largest value left after every control-flow breach was refactored away. Control flow keeps the defaults: cyclomaticComplexity, essentialComplexity, moduleDesignComplexity, globalDataComplexity and specifiedDataComplexity are not set here.
$comment.scopeDepthRatio: Python counts the function body as depth 1, so a flat 3-line function scores 1.67 against the default 1.3. Largest: mix._merge_named at 3.0, a 3-level loop over named design sections that must reject duplicate names.
$comment.halsteadEffort: Arithmetic expressions multiply operators and operands. Largest: mix.rbj at 56086, the RBJ biquad cookbook formulas for 7 filter kinds. Splitting a formula hides it.
$comment.halsteadVolume: Largest: fixtures.project at 3640, a test-fixture table that builds a whole demo project (cues, sources, licences) in one place.
$comment.halsteadDifficulty: Largest: mix.rbj at 38.6, the RBJ biquad cookbook formulas (DSP formula).
$comment.maintainabilityIndex: The index falls with Halstead volume, so numeric code and fixture tables score low. Lowest: fixtures.project at 38.4, the test-fixture table.
$comment.peakLiveVariables: Signal code keeps arrays, rates and frame sizes live together. Largest: arrange.arrange at 19, which keeps the arc, tempo, bar length, track analysis and option values live to place cues on the beat grid.
$comment.abcScore: Numeric code assigns and calls more per line. Largest: analyze.music_features at 52.3, 1 call per librosa feature (fixed API: tempo, beats, chroma, key, onset, spectral values).
$comment.variableSpan: Largest: fixtures.project at 46, a test-fixture table whose values are defined at the top and used in the records below.
$comment.scopeDepthWeightedLoc: Largest: qa.detect_clicks at 54, a per-channel filter, candidate search and de-duplicate pass over the samples (DSP loop).
